profile.name: Bambu Lab 3D打印机
profile.description: 这是一类 Bambu Lab 桌面级熔融沉积成型（FDM）3D打印机，可用于实验室中的快速原型制作、夹具治具加工、样件验证和教学演示。设备通常支持远程任务管理、打印状态监测、摄像头查看，并可结合 AMS 自动供料系统进行多材料或多色打印。
profile.description_en: This is a family of Bambu Lab desktop fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printers used in laboratories for rapid prototyping, fixture and jig fabrication, sample validation, and teaching demonstrations. The printers commonly support remote job management, print-status monitoring, camera viewing, and can work with the AMS automatic material system for multi-material or multi-color printing.
